text:
jess-sales: Quick sync — customer wants POC scope + cost estimate for secure assistant.
kevin-cust: timeline is 6 weeks. success = accurate answers on 10k prompts + <150ms median token latency for UI.
sam-se: Can we confirm workload? avg prompt 180 tokens, avg response 220 tokens, peak RPS 15, sustained 5.
lina-infra: For generation-heavy workloads at 15 RPS with those sizes we should consider 2x A100-80GB or 1x H100 with batching. latency depends on batching window.
jess-sales: Budget constraint: customer flagged $12k/month for POC infra — is that doable?
tom-finance: $12k/mo could cover 2x A100 reserved for a month on our dedicated plan + infra overhead maybe tight. need cost estimate including egress and storage.
sam-se: Quick calc: tokens/hour = (prompt+response)*RPS*3600 = (400)*15*3600 = 21,600,000 tokens/hr. For 8-hour peak => 172.8M tokens/day. For 10-day POC => ~1.7B tokens. Pricing at hosted rates will be significant.
kevin-cust: That token count seems high — our app has user think-time, peaks are short. can we model 5 RPS sustained and 15 RPS bursts using autoscale?
sam-se: Yes — recommended config: baseline 1 GPU for 5 RPS sustained, autoscale to 2 GPUs for bursts. Use KV cache for repeated prefixes to cut token generation ~20%.
lina-infra: Also enable continuous batching and max_batch_size 32, batch_wait 20ms. For H100 consider int8 quantized builds if accuracy tolerates.
security-bot: Security checklist: need SSO (SAML), IP allowlist, audit logs, and data-at-rest encryption. Customer has infosec questionnaire due Wed.
kevin-cust: We'll share the questionnaire today. Also need model evals — 1k labeled prompts to measure correctness; can we run eval framework?
sam-se: Yes — we can run evals in week 2, produce confusion matrix and P0/P1 failure counts. That will be the pass/fail criteria along with latency SLA.
jess-sales: OK action items: SE to produce cost estimate + infra plan by EOD tomorrow, infra to give exact GPU SKU recommendation, security to confirm SSO/audit timeline, customer to send questionnaire and 1k prompt set. :thumbsup:
kevin-cust: Sending questionnaire now. thanks everyone.
lina-infra: Noted — I'll validate if H100 fit under $12k by sizing NV switch options and reserved pricing.
tom-finance: I'll draft a POC cost summary with options: hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid and include buffer for egress.
sam-se: If anyone wants the quick token calc snippet:
```
avg_prompt=180
avg_resp=220
rps=15
tokens_per_sec=(avg_prompt+avg_resp)*rps
tokens_per_hour=tokens_per_sec*3600
```
sam-se: Will share formal estimate tomorrow.
